title: CIA recent changes
description: The latest 30 change events, newest first: the head of changes.json, small enough for the page to load with its first screen. Stored at data/v1/cia/changes-recent.json. A view: it holds exactly the first 30 events (or all of them when there are fewer) of the list the verifier derives for cia-changes.schema.json, in the same order and with the same items.

events.description: Newest first by at, ties by id; at most 30.
